related.description: Manage your photos with Piwigo, a full featured open source photo gallery application for the web. Star us on Github! More than 200 plugins...
A self-hosted non-invasive single-binary photo gallery with a focus on speed and simplicity.
Self hosted alternative to Google Photos
A self-hosted open source photo management service. This is the repository of the backend.
Self-hosted open-source web gallery to view your photos and videos featuring mobile-friendly, tagging and AI powered image discovery
